scenes.setting: Saint Anthony leads Nighthawks through the wrecked hall into an underground that has been swept clean — no guards, no blue door, and walls melted into raw mud and rock. 'Try divination. Search the vicinity.'

Soaked, feverish and sneezing through pathless forest: no fire, because the Church's questions would put Klein Moretti's old colleagues face to face with him and raise the matter of a summoned descendant of Death — better that Sherlock Moriarty be declared dead
scenes.text_anchor: He sure lived up to his name and identity…

scenes.setting: The world saturates and Azik is walking beside him: Zangwill survives but is hurt and pinned to the royal family, 0-08 will never willingly help its owner, and Klein should leave Backlund; a Card of Blasphemy is promised in thanks, the Underworld is placed inside the spirit world — and a thin human-skin glove changes hands, Creeping Hunger
scenes.text_anchor: “but to an Undying, this isn’t a big problem.”
